mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the remembered animal into an imagined beast was most worthwhile: it showed creativity as recombining familiar features.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment in the cave was a straightforward preparation, but less engaging than making the images.

surprise.text: Memory produced a painting of a real remembered animal rather than the imaginary creature I expected; adding a story made the difference.

arbitrary.text: The echo-to-song connection was understandable, although remembering an echo alone felt like a somewhat compressed route to making music.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the chapter connected creative acts to clear ideas, especially imagination and reflected sound, though the placement step was less engaging.
